harbor-rewardkit 0.1.7 source inside cw-editor-verifier:current (runner.py discover/_build_judge_reward, judges.py build_prompt/_arun_agent_individual/_arun_agent_call, agents.py expandvars, models.py JudgeMode)
evidence: scoring.toml is byte-identical in content to the template: [gates] render=0.0 constraints=0.0, [weights] functional 0.6/polish 0.2/visual 0.2 (sum 1), [floors] functional=0.05; every named dimension has a directory (tests/gates/{render,constraints}, tests/scored/{functional,polish,visual}). All five judge.toml files carry [judge] judge="claude-code" with mode/timeout/isolated=false/prompt_template="prompt.md" and no model/reasoning/temperature/weight; each declares the Playwright MCP server with the template args; gates use aggregation all_pass with one binary criterion each (server_backed_local_application, authenticated_render); scored use weighted_mean (functional 16 binary, polish 6 binary, visual 4 likert points=5); ids unique, id==name, weights positive, descriptions non-empty. Only scored/functional/judge.toml:22-27 declares the verifier server: command /usr/local/bin/python3, args ["/tests/tools/restart_mcp.py", "$APP_RESTART_HELPER"], matching test.sh:193 `export APP_RESTART_HELPER="$LOG_DIR/app-restart.sh"` (exported before run_suite) and rewardkit agents.py:66 os.path.expandvars on MCP args; test.sh, tools/restart_mcp.py, tools/score.py, tests/Dockerfile diff identical to the frozen template. Every prompt.md contains exactly one {criteria} and one {app_context}, no other braces; test.sh substitutes {app_context} from tests/app_context.md and rewardkit build_prompt uses str.replace for {criteria}. Actual run: I executed rewardkit.runner.discover() from the pinned harbor-rewardkit 0.1.7 in cw-editor-verifier:current against the read-only frozen tests (gates and scored): all five dimensions loaded without error (constraints/render AgentJudge batched 600 all_pass 1 Binary; functional AgentJudge individual 550 with playwright+verifier servers, 16 Binary, weighted_mean; polish batched 900 6 Binary; visual batched 900 4 Likert). The one deviation from template is functional mode="individual", timeout=550 (template batched/9000); models.py JudgeMode=Literal["batched","individual"] makes it valid, judges.py _arun_agent_individual runs criteria sequentially with the timeout per criterion, and the in-file comment (judge.toml:7-11) records reason, lead authorization (8 Oct) and budget math 16x550+900+900=10600 < 11100 scored suite; gates 2x600 < 1500; 1500+11100 < 13200 verifier. Single-use restart marker (restart_mcp.py:29-32, file-based) survives per-criterion MCP respawn in individual mode, and only the persistence criterion calls restart_app (functional/prompt.md:65-72). Broken app that could pass: none via wiring - gates are binary all_pass ahead of scored and floor protects polish/visual; conforming app that could fail: none from structure. Risk=true because the individual/550s functional configuration and the end-to-end restart MCP wiring have not been exercised by a full configured judge run on these bytes (raw-evidence-index scope explicitly says such a run is absent); this is runtime evidence for workload rows rather than a structural defect.
